units: world units; one tile of the engine map is one unit square
origin: each asset's origin is its base, in the middle of its footprint (the bridge is brought back to its own centre)
textures: textured materials paint one canvas each at load (RGBA8, sRGB, 256 px square, 128 px on the low tier, repeat-wrapped, anisotropy 4) and use the same canvas as their bump map; tinted variants share it. Trees and people carry their colours in their vertices and use no texture.
ambientOcclusion: no occlusion is baked into building textures; on the medium and high tiers the finishing chain adds screen-space ambient occlusion. Trees darken toward the trunk and the underside of each crown in their vertex colours.
